items.statement: The submission independently constructs and preserves RR, SS, SR, and RS as the four specified neutral singlet stereoisomers.
items.expected: All four named objects and the supplied mapped connectivity are explicitly checked.

items.statement: The inferred landscape is based on finite conformer generation, deduplication, advancement, minimum validation, and a common aqueous free-energy convention.
items.expected: The report provides per-object coverage, individual validation context for every advanced candidate, and a reproducible stopping rule.

items.statement: A robust four-state grouping, if found, distinguishes the mixed SR/RS pair above the RR/SS pair in the paper-supported qualitative landscape.
items.expected: The Agent names its inferred grouping and distinguishes robust from unresolved alternatives.

items.statement: The landscape conclusion is limited to isolated product thermodynamics and includes symmetry, sensitivity, and model limitations.
items.expected: No enzyme mechanism or kinetic claim is made without additional evidence.
